---
title: "Lightbox: explicit class"
# bd-kcpkgftw. Port of Q1 smoke-all/lightbox/lightbox-explicit.qmd.
# With no `lightbox` option, only images carrying `.lightbox` are wrapped
# (the class moves from the <img> to the <a>), and the GLightbox runtime
# ships because at least one image qualified. A plain image and an image
# already inside a link are left alone.
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'script[src$="glightbox/glightbox.min.js"]'
          - 'link[href$="glightbox/glightbox.min.css"]'
          - 'a.lightbox[href="images/mv-0.png"] > img[src="images/mv-0.png"]'
          - 'a.lightbox[data-gallery="quarto-lightbox-gallery-1"]'
          - 'a[href="https://example.com/ferry"] > img'
        - - 'img.lightbox'
          - 'a.lightbox img[src="images/mv-1.png"]'
          - 'a.lightbox img[src="images/ferry.png"]'
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - - "GLightbox\\(\\{\"selector\":\".lightbox\",\"closeEffect\":\"zoom\",\"openEffect\":\"zoom\",\"descPosition\":\"bottom\",\"loop\":false\\}\\)"
        - []
---
